versions.changelog:
Initial release providing structured project fund screening and diagnostics for VC/PE and government fund requirements.

- Automates project evaluation based on VC/PE investment stage and government guidance fund criteria.
- Outputs structured compliance scores, red flag checklists, and improvement suggestions.
- Supports both quick and detailed diagnosis, highlighting missing or insufficient project facts.
- Incorporates up-to-date policy standards (国办发〔2025〕1号, 2025-2026 regional details).
- Separates evaluations for financial and government investors, including city-level landing feasibility.
- Chinese-language support and clear documentation for process and reference files.
